summary: Drive a self-hosted gitrakz instance — the tool that syncs a GitHub user's activity into local SQLite, renders a filterable timeline and derived work sessions, and runs deterministic programmatic templates that export to CSV/PDF/JSON. Install or run it with Docker, then query its bearer-protected REST API under /api/v1 (owners, repos, timeline, sessions, sync + sync status, templates CRUD, LLM template generation, run, export) — or drive the same capabilities as MCP tools over streamable HTTP (/mcp) or stdio (`gitrakz mcp`). Use when the user wants to set up gitrakz, trigger or check a GitHub activity sync, pull a timeline or work-sessions timesheet, or run and export a template.
